sections.heading: Other Sekhmets
sections.text:
Rassimov's Suits invoked Sekhmet alongside Ammit Heart-Eater in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. They were, however, defeated by a trap which fired arrows triggered by Dante's Farslip power. [Memory Lane]

Sekhmet was used by one of Rassimov's Suits during the attack on Hippolyta and the Amazons. Sekhmet was defeated by Forest Queen Diana. [Ladies' Choice]

Rassimov invoked Sekhmet to fight Lok's Baselaird. [Coming of Age]

One of Rassimov's Suits used Sekhmet to attack Sophie Casterwill. Sabriel then fought off Sekhmet. [The Golden Asp]

Rassimov's Sekhmet Titan was unbonded from him by Dante's Sorrowbond spell and her Amulet taken to the Huntik Foundation. [Rassimov's Secret]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Sekhmet is highly skilled at sword play. She is fast, strong, agile and dangerous. Her teeth and claws can also be effective weapons. Being a humanoid cat-like titan, she also has the enhanced senses and stealth of a cat. This then means that if she can sneak up on a target, then it is almost certainly doomed. This makes Sekhmet an excellent Titan for assassins and her martial arts are skilled enough for her to fight against [[Sabriel]]. Sekhmet can use two blades to stab her foes or defend herself from attacks.

full_text:
Sekhmet is a Hecto-Titan with the body of a purple-furred lioness. Her garb is similar to that of Egyptian royalty. She uses her two scimitars to protect her Seeker, whether a pharaoh or an Organization operative.

== History ==
In ancient history, Sekhmet inspired the myths of the Egyptian goddess, Sekhmet, a warrior goddess of vengeance, divine punishment, fire, and healing. She was a very powerful protector of the pharaoh. [wikipedia:Sekhmet] A collection of Sekhmet Amulets came into possession of the Organization and were distributed to their Egyptian operatives under Klaus. [All Work and No Pay]

=== Suit 031's Sekhmet ===
Unnamed Suit 031's Sekhmet was invoked alongside those of unnamed Suits 032 and 033 at the Tomb of Nefertiti. His Sekhmet attacked Lok Lambert's Freelancer but was defeated. [All Work and No Pay] His Sekhmet again was invoked when pursuing Dante's team within the tomb and fought against Caliban before being stunned by a double Touchram from Zhalia Moon and Dante. [The Sceptre Deception]

=== Suit 032's Sekhmet ===
Unnamed Suit 032's Sekhmet was invoked alongside those of unnamed Suits 031 and 033 at the Tomb of Nefertiti. His Sekhmet attacked Sophie Casterwill but was defeated by Sabriel. [All Work and No Pay]

=== Suit 033's Sekhmet ===
Unnamed Suit 033's Sekhmet was invoked alongside those of unnamed Suits 031 and 033 at the Tomb of Nefertiti. His Sekhmet attacked Zhalia Moon and later was joined by unnamed Suit 035's Sekhmet and Klaus' Brahe to force the Huntik team to retreat. [All Work and No Pay]

=== Suit 035's Sekhmet ===
Unnamed Suit 035's Sekhmet joined unnamed Suit 033's Sekhmet and Klaus' Brahe to force the Huntik team to retreat. [All Work and No Pay]

=== Other Sekhmets ===
Rassimov's Suits invoked Sekhmet alongside Ammit Heart-Eater in the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot. They were, however, defeated by a trap which fired arrows triggered by Dante's Farslip power. [Memory Lane]

Sekhmet was used by one of Rassimov's Suits during the attack on Hippolyta and the Amazons. Sekhmet was defeated by Forest Queen Diana. [Ladies' Choice]

Rassimov invoked Sekhmet to fight Lok's Baselaird. [Coming of Age]

One of Rassimov's Suits used Sekhmet to attack Sophie Casterwill. Sabriel then fought off Sekhmet. [The Golden Asp]

Rassimov's Sekhmet Titan was unbonded from him by Dante's Sorrowbond spell and her Amulet taken to the Huntik Foundation. [Rassimov's Secret]

== Abilities ==
Sekhmet is highly skilled at sword play. She is fast, strong, agile and dangerous. Her teeth and claws can also be effective weapons. Being a humanoid cat-like titan, she also has the enhanced senses and stealth of a cat. This then means that if she can sneak up on a target, then it is almost certainly doomed. This makes Sekhmet an excellent Titan for assassins and her martial arts are skilled enough for her to fight against Sabriel. Sekhmet can use two blades to stab her foes or defend herself from attacks.
